messages:
Casey Romero: Hey team — first day as AE. Quick asks: Salesforce seat, Aircall desktop extension, Gong invite + retention note for enterprise demos, and access to 'Enterprise AE' playbook + enterprise pitch deck. Who do I ping? :wave:
Maya Lin: welcome Casey! :tada: Pinged SalesOps. I handle SF + Aircall. Can you confirm work email and time zone?
Casey Romero: casey.romero@redwood.ai, PST. Also prefer desktop Aircall.
Maya Lin: created ticket SOPS-9999 for SF + Aircall. SF ETA ~4 hours after PeopleOps approval. Aircall invite should be same-day. Added 2FA steps in the ticket.
Noah Rivera: RevOps here — I'll send the Gong invite and set recording retention to 90 days for enterprise demos unless Legal requests otherwise. Ticket REV-4420 created.
Hannah Cho: CS partner here. For handoffs use the Notion template: https://redwood-internal/notion/cs-handoff. Please fill "expected_mrr" and "integration_scope" fields or handoffs stall.
Casey Romero: Got the Notion link, thanks. I can't download the enterprise pitch deck (403). Any ideas?
Maya Lin: Permissions issue — fixing now, will update.
OpsBot: SYSTEM: Ticket SOPS-9999 created and assigned to Maya Lin. Status: in progress.
Noah Rivera: Gong invite sent. Note: transcripts access restricted to revenue-ops + security by default for demos. If you need exports, open a request.
LegalBot: SYSTEM: For enterprise demos with regulated customers, include the consent line in invites: "This session may be recorded for quality and training; recordings are retained per customer agreement." Legal contact: legal@redwood.ai
Maya Lin: SF seat provisioned (SOPS-9999). Invite sent. Please complete 2FA within 24 hours.
Casey Romero: Received SF invite and Gong. Download works now. One quick technical: CSV header for bulk lead import?
Maya Lin: Use this header for HubSpot/SF imports: ```
email,first_name,last_name,company,job_title,lead_source,lead_status,owner,region
```
Casey Romero: Excellent. Thanks everyone — will start mock calls tomorrow. Appreciate the fast turnarounds! :rocket:
Hannah Cho: Welcome aboard! Added you to AE_playbooks and scheduled a 30m CS handoff session for Monday 10am PT.
